rachel: Starting APAC staggered rollout 10% for embeddings-service v2.7.0. Change window open. Need quick stop/go from infra/product.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: release-id=rls-2026-04-21-6891241111, target=apac/*, percentage=10%, variant=v2.7.0, nodes=5.
kai: Hold please. p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 450ms in ap-southeast-1 at ~T+3m. Traces: https://traces.redwood/service/embeddings/apac
mike: +1 hold. Also seeing increased tail CPU on the infer nodes. Pod logs show repeated warnings: `quant_lib: unexpected kernel selection, fallback to scalar path`.
ops-oncall: Collecting flamegraphs. Could be kernel selector picking non-vectorized path for the new quant tables.
security: No anomaly in auth logs, but noticed additional model variant env var `QUANT_PROFILE=v2_high` in new image. Who changed release notes?
rachel: Release notes showed quant improvements under testing. We should avoid global rollback. Proposal: regional pinback to v2.6.8 in APAC and pause rollout in other regions until triage.
kai: Agree. Also propose re-running canary with `QUANT_PROFILE=v2_low` to repro locally.
deploy-bot: Received: `pin-version --region=apac --version=v2.6.8 --retain=100% --until=manual`. Applying routing change...
deploy-bot: Routing update complete. APAC traffic pinned to v2.6.8. Current v2.7.0 percentage in apac: 0%.
mike: Metrics after pin: p95 down to ~130ms, CPU normalized. Good catch.
ops-oncall: Filing incident INC-1240, tag=release, owner=kai. Attaching perf dumps.
security: Recommend adding QUANT_PROFILE to the rollout playbook as a kill switch param. Also request a short blameless note in the release notes for internal tracking.
rachel: Agreed. Action items: (1) kai will reproduce with v2_high vs v2_low on a canary, (2) mike will add quick rollback knob to runbook, (3) product will update release notes to call out quant profile changes next time. Re-rollout blocked until +1 sign-off.
kai: Starting repro now on canary-embed-03. Will report within 20m.
mike: Adding temporary gate: `rollout.safety.quant_profile` to the release config.
rachel: Thanks — APAC pinned, global rollout paused. We'll reconvene at +20 unless earlier update. :white_check_mark:
